root_cause.text: In `wl1271_op_resume()`, the `mutex_lock(&wl->mutex)` was placed after the `pm_runtime_force_resume()` call, so if that call failed, the function would reach an unlock path (e.g., via goto to an error label) without having acquired the mutex, resulting in an unlock of an unlocked mutex.
root_cause.evidence: The patch moves the `mutex_lock(&wl->mutex)` from after the spin unlock block to before the `pm_runtime_force_resume()` call, ensuring the mutex is held even in the error path. The CVE description and commit message confirm this was detected by the Clang thread‑safety analyzer as a locking bug.
